verdict.text: Fails to launch when built with the iOS 27 SDK.

findings.title: No scene configuration
findings.message: Info.plist has no UIApplicationSceneManifest, and AppDelegate does not implement application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:). Built with the iOS 27 SDK, the app stops at launch: "UIScene life cycle is required for apps built with this SDK".

fix.title: Turn on scene support (Expo SDK 57)
steps: Use expo 57.0.23 or later and expo-build-properties 57.0.20 or later (npx expo install expo-build-properties).
In app.json, add ["expo-build-properties", { "ios": { "enableSceneSupport": true } }] to plugins.
Regenerate the native project: npx expo prebuild --clean -p ios. ExpoAppSceneDelegate then creates the window and passes links, user activities and quick actions on to AppDelegate.

sources.title: expo/expo#46664: Xcode 27 support for Expo SDK 57
expo/expo#50191: backport UIKit scene lifecycle runtime

alternatives.title: Temporary: install react-native-uiscene-bridge
steps: Adds a scene configuration at run time, moves the app delegate's window into the scene and passes links, user activities, quick actions and foreground and background events back to the app delegate.
Limit: Tested in the simulator only, not on a device (its README).
Limit: One window: iPad multiwindow needs real scene support.
Limit: Universal links, Handoff and quick actions were not tested (its README).
Limit: iOS only: Mac Catalyst is untested; tvOS and visionOS are not supported.

sources.title: Apple: Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle

findings.title: Window created in the app delegate
findings.message: AppDelegate creates the window with UIWindow(frame:). With a scene, UIKit does not show a window that belongs to no scene, and the app opens to a black screen.

findings.title: application(_:open:options:) is not called with scenes
findings.message: UIKit does not call this method once the app uses scenes. Use scene(_:openURLContexts:), and connectionOptions.urlContexts in scene(_:willConnectTo:options:) for a link that launches the app.
